english.title: Use on a road a coach / bus fitted with a speed limiter which failed to comply with regulations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[coach]_
(B)_[bus]_

namely **(..SPECIFY..), when fitted with a speed limiter which did not comply with

(C)_[regulation 36A(5)(a) in that it was not sealed]_
(D)_[regulation 36A(5)(b) in that it was not maintained in good and efficient working order]_
(E)_[regulation 36A(6) in that it was not calibrated to a set speed not exceeding 70 mph]_
(F)_[regulation 36A(7) in that it was not adjusted so that the stabilised speed of the bus did not exceed 65 mph]_
(G)_[regulation 36A(8) in that it did not comply with Part 1 of the British Standard or the annexes to Community Directive 92/24]_
(H)_[regulation 36A(9) in that it (not being a speed limiter to which regulation 36A(8) applied) did not comply with the annexes to Community Directive 92/24]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 36A(4) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Option E applies to coaches only
(ii) Option F applies to buses only.
(iii) Option G applies to a speed limiter fitted to a coach at any time and to a bus before 1.10.94 But does not apply in either instance if fitted before 1.10.88.
(iv) Option G does not apply if speed limiter complies with an equivalent standard as at regulation 36a(14).
(v) Option H applies to a speed limiter fitted to a bus after 1.10.94.
(vi) See regulation 3(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 for meaning of "bus" and "coach".
(vii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(viii) See also offence wordings: H1334 and H1335.
